hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the diagonal template M(theta, theta) at theta=1 and theta=2; the observed sum is the sum of these two specializations.
required_assumptions: M is a binary function symbol whose arguments may be substituted independently.
The structural family is the diagonal specialization M(theta, theta), not a simplification of M itself.
hypotheses.rationale: Both subexpressions use the same binary function M with equal arguments; they differ only by the numeric diagonal value, so a one-parameter diagonal template explains both non-identical instances.
